package.name: mowgli_airseekers_bridge
package.description: Hardware bridge for the Airseekers Tron: speaks the vendor MCU's serial protocol, reads the WIT JY61P IMU and the top-panel keys, and publishes the exact hardware_bridge ROS2 contract MowgliNext expects (status, emergency, power, battery, IMU, wheel odometry, blade and e-stop services). Runs as its own sidecar container next to mowgli-ros2 when HARDWARE_BACKEND=airseekers; the vendor firmware is left untouched.
